- [Overview](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/index.md)
- [List Apps](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/apps/list-apps.md): List all apps with the ability to filter by organization slug.
- [Create App](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/apps/create-app.md): Create an app with the specified details in the request body.
- [Get App](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/apps/get-app.md): Retrieve details about a specific app by its name.
- [Destroy App](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/apps/destroy-app.md): Delete an app by its name.
- [Create App deploy token](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/apps/create-app-deploy-token.md)
- [List IP assignments for app](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/apps/list-ip-assignments-for-app.md)
- [Assign new IP address to app](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/apps/assign-new-ip-address-to-app.md)
- [Remove IP assignment from app](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/apps/remove-ip-assignment-from-app.md)
- [List Machines](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/list-machines.md): List all Machines associated with a specific app, with optional filters for including deleted Machines and filtering by region.
- [Create Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/create-machine.md): Create a Machine within a specific app using the details provided in the request body.
- [Get Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/get-machine.md): Get details of a specific Machine within an app by the Machine ID.
- [Update Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/update-machine.md): Update a Machine's configuration using the details provided in the request body.
- [Destroy Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/destroy-machine.md): Delete a specific Machine within an app by Machine ID, with an optional force parameter to force kill the Machine if it's running.
- [Cordon Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/cordon-machine.md): “Cordoning” a Machine refers to disabling its services, so the Fly Proxy won’t route requests to it. In flyctl this is used by blue/green deployments; one set of Machines is started up with services disabled, and when they are all healthy, the services are enabled on the new Machines and disabled on…
- [List Events](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/list-events.md): List all events associated with a specific Machine within an app.
- [Execute Command](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/execute-command.md): Execute a command on a specific Machine and return the raw command output bytes.
- [Get Lease](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/get-lease.md): Retrieve the current lease of a specific Machine within an app. Machine leases can be used to obtain an exclusive lock on modifying a Machine.
- [Create Lease](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/create-lease.md): Create a lease for a specific Machine within an app using the details provided in the request body. Machine leases can be used to obtain an exclusive lock on modifying a Machine.
- [Release Lease](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/release-lease.md): Release the lease of a specific Machine within an app. Machine leases can be used to obtain an exclusive lock on modifying a Machine.
- [Get Machine Memory](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/get-machine-memory.md): Get current memory limit and available capacity for a machine
- [Set Machine Memory Limit](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/set-machine-memory-limit.md): Set the memory limit for a machine using the balloon device
- [Reclaim Machine Memory](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/reclaim-machine-memory.md): Trigger the balloon device to reclaim memory from a machine
- [Get Metadata](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/get-metadata.md): Retrieve metadata for a specific Machine within an app.
- [Update Metadata (deprecated PUT alias of PATCH)](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/update-metadata-deprecated-put-alias-of-patch.md): Deprecated: use `PATCH` on the same path, which this is identical to. + Despite the method, this does not replace the metadata: keys that are not in the request are left untouched. Null values and empty strings remove keys. + If `machine_version` is provided and no longer matches the current machine…
- [Update Metadata (set/remove multiple keys)](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/update-metadata-setremove-multiple-keys.md): Update multiple metadata keys at once. Keys that are not in the request are left untouched. Null values and empty strings remove keys. + If `machine_version` is provided and no longer matches the current machine version, returns 412 Precondition Failed.
- [Get Metadata Value](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/get-metadata-value.md): Get the value of a specific metadata key
- [Upsert Metadata Key](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/upsert-metadata-key.md): Update metadata for a specific machine within an app by providing a metadata key.
- [Delete Metadata](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/delete-metadata.md): Delete metadata for a specific Machine within an app by providing a metadata key.
- [List Processes](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/list-processes.md): List all processes running on a specific Machine within an app, with optional sorting parameters.
- [Restart Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/restart-machine.md): Restart a specific Machine within an app, with an optional timeout parameter.
- [Signal Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/signal-machine.md): Send a signal to a specific Machine within an app using the details provided in the request body.
- [Start Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/start-machine.md): Start a specific Machine within an app.
- [Stop Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/stop-machine.md): Stop a specific Machine within an app, with an optional request body to specify signal and timeout.
- [Suspend Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/suspend-machine.md): Suspend a specific Machine within an app. The next start operation will attempt (but is not guaranteed) to resume the Machine from a snapshot taken at suspension time, rather than performing a cold boot.
- [Uncordon Machine](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/uncordon-machine.md): “Cordoning” a Machine refers to disabling its services, so the Fly Proxy won’t route requests to it. In flyctl this is used by blue/green deployments; one set of Machines is started up with services disabled, and when they are all healthy, the services are enabled on the new Machines and disabled on…
- [List Versions](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/list-versions.md): List all versions of the configuration for a specific Machine within an app.
- [Wait for State](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/machines/wait-for-state.md): Wait for a Machine to reach a specific state. Specify the desired state with the state parameter. See the [Machine states table](https://fly.io/docs/machines/working-with-machines/#machine-states) for a list of possible states. The default for this parameter is `started`.
- [List Volumes](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/volumes/list-volumes.md): List all volumes associated with a specific app.
- [Create Volume](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/volumes/create-volume.md): Create a volume for a specific app using the details provided in the request body.
- [Get Volume](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/volumes/get-volume.md): Retrieve details about a specific volume by its ID within an app.
- [Update Volume](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/volumes/update-volume.md): Update a volume's configuration using the details provided in the request body.
- [Destroy Volume](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/volumes/destroy-volume.md): Delete a specific volume within an app by volume ID.
- [Extend Volume](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/volumes/extend-volume.md): Extend a volume's size within an app using the details provided in the request body.
- [List Snapshots](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/volumes/list-snapshots.md): List all snapshots for a specific volume within an app.
- [Create Snapshot](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/volumes/create-snapshot.md): Create a snapshot for a specific volume within an app.
- [List Postgres Clusters](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/list-postgres-clusters.md): List Managed Postgres clusters for an organization.
- [Create Postgres Cluster](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/create-postgres-cluster.md): Create a Managed Postgres cluster for the organization named in the request body. Provisioning is asynchronous: poll `GET /v1/postgres/{id}` until `status == ready` before calling database, user, extension, or credential endpoints.
- [Get Postgres Cluster](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/get-postgres-cluster.md): Get details of a specific Managed Postgres cluster.
- [Delete Postgres Cluster](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/delete-postgres-cluster.md): Delete a Managed Postgres cluster. The cluster is marked for deletion and removed asynchronously.
- [Attach Cluster to App](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/attach-cluster-to-app.md): Record an attachment between a cluster and a Fly app. This endpoint records the relationship but does not set DATABASE_URL or other app secrets; configure the connection string separately. The attachment is created if it does not already exist.
- [Detach Cluster from App](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/detach-cluster-from-app.md): Detach a specific cluster from a Fly app.
- [List Backups](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/list-backups.md): List all backups associated with a specific cluster.
- [Create Backup](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/create-backup.md): Create a backup for a specific cluster. The backup runs asynchronously and is rejected if one is already in progress.
- [List Databases](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/list-databases.md): List all databases within a specific cluster.
- [Create Database](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/create-database.md): Create a database within a specific cluster.
- [Drop Database](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/drop-database.md): Delete a specific database within a cluster, along with objects that depend on it.
- [List Extensions](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/list-extensions.md): List all extensions available within a specific database, indicating which are installed.
- [Enable Extension](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/enable-extension.md): Enable a Postgres extension within a specific database. PostGIS extensions require a PostGIS-enabled cluster.
- [Disable Extension](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/disable-extension.md): Disable a specific Postgres extension within a database, optionally dropping objects that depend on it. System extensions cannot be disabled.
- [Fork Cluster to New Cluster](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/fork-cluster-to-new-cluster.md): Fork a ready Managed Postgres cluster into a new cluster that inherits the source's settings. The source cluster is left unchanged, and the fork is provisioned asynchronously.
- [List Active Queries](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/list-active-queries.md): List active queries in the supplied database. The database query parameter is required and must not be empty or whitespace-only. Returns full query text and durations in seconds.
- [List Slow Queries](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/list-slow-queries.md): List the top 20 queries by cumulative total execution time, excluding the postgres database. Uses the latest available metrics within the lookback range; statistics are cumulative PostgreSQL counters, not deltas over that range. Returns full query text and execution times in seconds.
- [Restore Backup or Point in Time to New Cluster](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/restore-backup-or-point-in-time-to-new-cluster.md): Restore a backup, or a point in time within the cluster's PITR recovery window, into a new Managed Postgres cluster. The source cluster is left unchanged, and a new cluster is provisioned asynchronously.
- [List Users](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/list-users.md): List all Postgres users within a specific cluster.
- [Create User](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/create-user.md): Create a Postgres user within a specific cluster. Fetch the generated password from the credentials endpoint.
- [Delete User](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/delete-user.md): Delete a specific Postgres user within a cluster.
- [Update User Role](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/update-user-role.md): Update a specific Postgres user's role within a cluster.
- [Get User Credentials](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/get-user-credentials.md): Get the connection credentials for a specific Postgres user within a cluster.
- [Rotate User Password](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/postgres-clusters/rotate-user-password.md): Rotate a specific Postgres user's password within a cluster, optionally terminating the user's existing sessions.
- [List secret keys belonging to an app](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/list-secret-keys-belonging-to-an-app.md)
- [Get an app's secret key](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/get-an-apps-secret-key.md)
- [Create or update a secret key](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/create-or-update-a-secret-key.md)
- [Delete an app's secret key](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/delete-an-apps-secret-key.md)
- [Decrypt with a secret key](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/decrypt-with-a-secret-key.md)
- [Encrypt with a secret key](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/encrypt-with-a-secret-key.md)
- [Generate a random secret key](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/generate-a-random-secret-key.md)
- [Sign with a secret key](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/sign-with-a-secret-key.md)
- [Verify with a secret key](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/verify-with-a-secret-key.md)
- [List app secrets belonging to an app](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/list-app-secrets-belonging-to-an-app.md)
- [Update app secrets belonging to an app](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/update-app-secrets-belonging-to-an-app.md)
- [Get an app secret](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/get-an-app-secret.md)
- [Create or update Secret](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/create-or-update-secret.md)
- [Delete an app secret](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/secrets/delete-an-app-secret.md)
- [List certificates for app](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tls-certificates/list-certificates-for-app.md)
- [Request ACME certificate](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tls-certificates/request-acme-certificate.md)
- [Upload custom certificate](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tls-certificates/upload-custom-certificate.md)
- [Get certificate details](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tls-certificates/get-certificate-details.md)
- [Remove certificate](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tls-certificates/remove-certificate.md)
- [Remove ACME certificates](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tls-certificates/remove-acme-certificates.md)
- [Check DNS and re-validate certificate](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tls-certificates/check-dns-and-re-validate-certificate.md)
- [Remove custom certificate](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tls-certificates/remove-custom-certificate.md)
- [Authenticate token header](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tokens/authenticate-token-header.md): Verify a token header without checking resource access.
- [Authorize token for resource access](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tokens/authorize-token-for-resource-access.md): Verify a token header and validate it against a requested access scope.
- [Get Current Token Information](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tokens/get-current-token-information.md): Get information about the current macaroon token(s), including organizations, apps, user identity hashes, and machine restrictions
- [Request a Petsem token for accessing KMS](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tokens/request-a-petsem-token-for-accessing-kms.md)
- [Request an OIDC token](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/tokens/request-an-oidc-token.md): Request an Open ID Connect token for your machine. Customize the audience claim with the `aud` parameter. This returns a JWT token. Learn more about [using OpenID Connect](/docs/reference/openid-connect/) on Fly.io.
- [List All Machines](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/organizations/list-all-machines.md): List all Machines associated with a specific organization. Machines are sorted by their `updated_at` timestamps, oldest to newest.
- [List All Volumes](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/organizations/list-all-volumes.md): List all volumes for an organization with optional filters and cursor-based pagination.
- [Get Placements](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/platform/get-placements.md): Simulates placing the specified number of machines into regions, depending on available capacity and limits.
- [Get Regions](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/platform/get-regions.md): List all regions on the platform with their details.
- [Models](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/models.md): Schema reference for every object in the Fly Machines API.

- [List connectors](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/connectors/list-connectors.md): List connectors configured for the authenticated organization.
- [Create an API-key connector](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/connectors/create-an-api-key-connector.md): Create a connector from a user-provided API key for providers that support key validation.
- [Provision a connector](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/connectors/provision-a-connector.md): Provision a system-managed connector for providers that support platform-managed keys.
- [Get a connector](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/connectors/get-a-connector.md): Get a single connector by ID.
- [Update a connector](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/connectors/update-a-connector.md): Update a connector access policy.
- [Delete a connector](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/connectors/delete-a-connector.md): Delete a connector and its encrypted credentials.
- [Update a connector](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/connectors/update-a-connector-1.md): Update a connector access policy.
- [Authorize an OAuth connector](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/connectors/authorize-an-oauth-connector.md): Create an OAuth authorization URL for a provider. Use this to start a browser-based consent flow.
- [Complete OAuth authorization](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/connectors/complete-oauth-authorization.md): Exchange an OAuth authorization code for an encrypted connector.
- [List sprites](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/sprites/list-sprites.md): List all sprites for the authenticated organization
- [Create a sprite](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/sprites/create-a-sprite.md): Create a new sprite with a unique name in your organization
- [Get a sprite](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/sprites/get-a-sprite.md): Get details for a specific sprite
- [Update a sprite](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/sprites/update-a-sprite.md): Update sprite settings such as URL authentication
- [Delete a sprite](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/sprites/delete-a-sprite.md): Delete a sprite and all associated resources
- [Create Checkpoint](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/checkpoints/create-checkpoint.md): Create a new checkpoint of the current sprite state. Returns streaming NDJSON progress.
- [List Checkpoints](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/checkpoints/list-checkpoints.md): List all checkpoints.
- [Get Checkpoint](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/checkpoints/get-checkpoint.md): Get details of a specific checkpoint.
- [Restore Checkpoint](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/checkpoints/restore-checkpoint.md): Restore to a specific checkpoint. Returns streaming NDJSON progress.
- [List Exec Sessions](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/exec/list-exec-sessions.md): List active exec sessions.
- [Execute Command](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/exec/execute-command.md): Execute a command via simple HTTP POST (non-TTY only). Simpler alternative for exec for environments that can't handle websockets.
- [Kill Exec Session](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/exec/kill-exec-session.md): Kill an exec session by session ID. Returns streaming NDJSON with kill progress.
- [Change File Mode](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/filesystem/change-file-mode.md): Change file or directory permissions.
- [Change File Owner](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/filesystem/change-file-owner.md): Change file or directory ownership.
- [Copy File or Directory](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/filesystem/copy-file-or-directory.md): Copy a file or directory.
- [Delete File or Directory](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/filesystem/delete-file-or-directory.md): Delete a file or directory.
- [List Directory](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/filesystem/list-directory.md): List directory contents.
- [Read File](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/filesystem/read-file.md): Read file contents from the sprite filesystem. Returns raw file bytes.
- [Rename File or Directory](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/filesystem/rename-file-or-directory.md): Rename or move a file or directory.
- [Write File](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/filesystem/write-file.md): Write file contents to the sprite filesystem. Request body contains raw file bytes.
- [Get Network Policy](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/network-policy/get-network-policy.md): Get the current network policy configuration.
- [Set Network Policy](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/network-policy/set-network-policy.md): Update the network policy configuration.
- [Get Privileges Policy](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/network-policy/get-privileges-policy.md): Get the current privileges policy configuration (capability and device restrictions).
- [Set Privileges Policy](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/network-policy/set-privileges-policy.md): Update the privileges policy configuration to restrict capabilities or devices.
- [Delete Privileges Policy](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/network-policy/delete-privileges-policy.md): Remove privileges policy to revert to default (unrestricted) behavior.
- [Get Resources Policy](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/network-policy/get-resources-policy.md): Get the current resources policy configuration (memory limits).
- [Set Resources Policy](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/network-policy/set-resources-policy.md): Update the resources policy configuration to set memory limits.
- [Delete Resources Policy](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/network-policy/delete-resources-policy.md): Remove resources policy to revert to default behavior.
- [List Services](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/services/list-services.md): List all configured services and their current state.
- [Get Service](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/services/get-service.md): Get details of a specific service.
- [Create Service](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/services/create-service.md): Create or update a service definition.
- [Get Service Logs](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/services/get-service-logs.md): Stream logs for a service.
- [Restart Service](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/services/restart-service.md): Restart a service (stop if running, then start). Returns streaming NDJSON with stop and start progress.
- [Start Service](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/services/start-service.md): Start a service. Returns streaming NDJSON with stdout/stderr.
- [Stop Service](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/services/stop-service.md): Stop a running service. Returns streaming NDJSON with service stop progress.
- [Execute Command](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/websockets/execute-command.md): Execute a command in the sprite environment via WebSocket. Commands continue running after disconnect; use `max_run_after_disconnect` to control timeout. Supports TTY and non-TTY modes.
- [Attach to Exec Session](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/websockets/attach-to-exec-session.md): Attach to an existing exec session via WebSocket.
- [TCP Proxy](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/websockets/tcp-proxy.md): Establish a WebSocket tunnel to a port inside the sprite environment.
- [Control Channel](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/websockets/control-channel.md): Multiplexed control channel for sequential operations (exec, proxy) over a single persistent WebSocket connection. Reduces connection overhead for clients sending many operations.
- [Watch Ports](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/websockets/watch-ports.md): Watch for port open/close events across all processes in the sprite namespace. On connect, sends a snapshot of all currently listening ports as a port_list message, then streams incremental port_opened/port_closed events.
- [Watch Filesystem](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/websockets/watch-filesystem.md): Watch for filesystem changes via WebSocket.
